TASK 10 — Navidrome artist images.

Files: `lib/features/shared/media_widgets.dart` (edit `ArtistListTile`) and `lib/features/artists/artist_details_screen.dart` (edit header image fallback).

Context: There is NO `resolveArtistImageUrl` helper and NO `ar-<id>` logic — do not add any. The captain has already added nothing extra here; you implement per the real structure.

1. `media_widgets.dart` — `ArtistListTile` currently shows only the first letter of the artist name as a placeholder. Change it so that IF `artist.artistImageUrl` is a valid absolute `http`/`https` URL (use `Uri.tryParse(...)` and check `isAbsolute` and scheme is http/https), it shows a `CircleAvatar` (or equivalent) with `backgroundImage: CachedNetworkImageProvider(artist.artistImageUrl)`. Otherwise keep the existing first-letter placeholder. This benefits both `ArtistsScreen` and search results that use `ArtistListTile`.

2. `artist_details_screen.dart` — the header image currently uses `ArtistInfo2.coverArt`, `largeImageUrl`, `mediumImageUrl`. Change the fallback ORDER to:
   1. `ArtistInfo2.coverArt`
   2. `largeImageUrl`
   3. `mediumImageUrl`
   4. `Artist.artistImageUrl` (only if it is a valid absolute http/https URL)
   5. first-letter placeholder
   Do NOT add an `ar-<id>` fallback and do NOT add URL-hash cacheKey logic. Just reorder the existing fallbacks and add `Artist.artistImageUrl` as the 4th option.

Look at how the existing code builds the artist image widget (CachedNetworkImage with a fallback builder) and slot the new ordering in.

Do NOT run any build/analyze/test (captain runs final verification). If the edit tool says "file changed since it was read", re-read the file fully and retry. Report when done.
